name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
tagline: Neural and WaveNet voices for speech synthesis
description: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech converts text into natural-sounding speech using WaveNet and neural voices. Supports SSML, many languages and voices, and audio formats such as LINEAR16, MP3, and OGG_OPUS. Developers call the REST API at texttospeech.googleapis.com (or client libraries) with Google Cloud credentials.

auth.details: Google Cloud OAuth2 access token (Bearer) or API key; typically service account or Application Default Credentials. API key can be passed as ?key= or x-goog-api-key header for some endpoints.

use_cases: convert product description text to spoken audio
generate voiceover narration from a script
synthesize accessibility audio for UI strings
create multi-language speech samples for testing
